# Flight Tribe

> Flight Tribe is a jewelry, accessories, and clothing brand founded by designer Johnny Flight — hand-cast .925 sterling silver and 24k gold, gem-set dice, winged hearts, the eagle seal, and the eye-in-vesica hallmark. Everything is hand-made in the USA. Tagline: "Move Different. Live Legendary."

Flight Tribe is not a mass-market label — every piece is cast, finished, and stamped by hand, one stone at a time. The brand is for collectors, creators, travelers, and anyone who doesn't follow the crowd.

## Notes

- Prices, stock, and product detail pages are rendered client-side from a live Shopify catalogue and change frequently — treat any cached page content as a snapshot, not current inventory.
- Checkout happens on Shopify's own hosted checkout, not on this domain.
